summary: An application of the TB translation platform: mouse PD is linked to published human PK, with binding sensitivity analysis and comparison to clinical bacterial counts.
validation: Uses clinical PK and clinical baseline counts, so it is not animal-only prediction of human PK. Shared platform with TB_TRANSLATION2023 must not be counted as independent methodological proof.
data_availability: Open supplementary DOCX and published model summaries; raw individual datasets and executable code not verified.
code_availability: Executable estimation code not verified; an accessible paper is not an executable model.
